name: Hermes Face
author: Pierre-Johan Goosen
description: What is an AI without a face? This one has it. A holographic head lives on your bar as a single glyph — idle, thinking, speaking or failed — and answers in your own agent's voice. Everything is included: the face ships inside this repository, so one install is the whole thing, with open, stop and restart a click away.

barWidget.description: Your agent's face, live: idle, thinking, speaking or failed, with open, stop and restart on one slot.
